facts.note: Watch exact; Félix 20 min behind, Girard 4 min behind, doctor 2 min ahead. The nine o'clock anchor is in the interviewer's question, and the witness does not contradict it.
Worked beside the master in the atelier after dinner; at ten the regulator agreed exactly with the temple striking.
Sent downstairs when the regulator showed twenty past ten; regulator was running and he was well.
Compared her watch with Rosa's clock in the kitchen; Rosa's clock exactly fifteen minutes fast.
Piano began at twelve minutes to eleven and stopped at one minute past eleven, both by the kitchen clock.
Went straight to the kitchen and stayed with Rosa from arrival until after the temple struck eleven.
